title: Evidence-Gated Sequential Learning (SII): Reproducibility Suite
description: Reproducibility materials for Gated Sequential Learning: Certification Ladders for Binary Identification under Endogenous Experiment Availability. The release contains theorem-matched synthetic benchmarks, record-envelope LP verification, rare-event false-unlock calibration, robustness stress tests, and two offline UCI sensing replays. The sharp theory is binary and known-model; multiclass and cross-subject experiments are explicitly treated as exploratory or robustness analyses.
